status: review-only; not wired into the build
policy: Records omitted from this file are deliberate keeps from the source-audited translation.

changes.TT3B/g0/r2: Woman: We've captured one escaped POW and one scientist. Schmidt: I'll take custody of them. Woman: Heil Hitler! Schmidt: Heil Hitler!
changes.TT3B/g0/r5: His hand rests on the trigger.
changes.TT3B/g0/r6: Simon: If only I could turn back time… I've found myself thinking that often lately.
changes.TT3B/g0/r7: Einstein was a genius. No… a child of God. His theory must never be used to build bombs!
changes.TT3B/g0/r9: Woman: Kill or be killed. That's war, isn't it?!
changes.TT3B/g0/r13: I clutch it tightly. Somehow, I feel a little braver.
changes.TT3B/g0/r14: Simon: A charm?! Me: Maybe a warding spell? The rust is covering the inscription. I can't quite make it out. Simon: Hmm…
changes.TT3B/g0/r16: Woman: There's nowhere left to run.
changes.TT3B/g0/r21: Schmidt: You actually made it. Impressive. Simon: I will not build another bomb… Schmidt: You're safe now. Simon: What?!
changes.TT3B/g0/r23: Schmidt's iron expression breaks into a sly grin. Schmidt: Rebecca has agents even inside the Nazi ranks. Simon: We're saved… Schmidt: Beyond that ridge is the lake on the Swiss border. Once you're in Switzerland, go to the American embassy…
changes.TT3B/g0/r24: Voice: Fool. Did you really think you could escape me?
changes.TT3B/g0/r28: Hitler: You cannot deceive these eyes, Colonel Schmidt. Behold the miserable fate of a traitor!
changes.TT3B/g0/r29: But none of us can hurt him!
changes.TT3B/g1/r4: They brace themselves for his attack!
changes.TT3B/g1/r6: My hands trembling, I take it and thrust it forward. Hitler: What?!
changes.TT3B/g1/r7: The charm flashes! Light sears his eyes! Hitler: Gwaaah!
changes.TT3B/g1/r8: The rust flakes away, revealing the words beneath!
changes.TT3B/g1/r9: Me: "Guide all wanderers…" But then… Hitler: Nooooo!!
changes.TT3B/g1/r13: Me: Read the inscription! Read it out loud! Cougar! Cougar!
changes.TT3B/g1/r15: Cougar: Aaaaah! Simon: G-God! Schmidt: My body's being torn apart!
changes.TT3B/g1/r19: Cougar: Guide all wanderers to the righteous path! Guard me on my journey! I serve God and praise His mercy and grace!
changes.TT3B/g1/r21: Cougar: There's nobody here… Simon: A vision? No. It was real. The Devil did this. The Devil stole my body. Simon: Someone spoke?! Schmidt: No… Cougar: …
changes.TT3B/g1/r22: Schmidt: The border is just ahead. Cougar: My mind's blank… Why am I here…? Simon: You must have struck your head badly. Schmidt: After an ordeal like that… Cougar: It might change the way I look at my whole life. Simon: Indeed…
changes.TT3B/g1/r23: Hitler: Please! Take me with you! Devil: No. You remain here. Keep doing evil until our pact expires next year. Hitler: Next year?! Devil: April 30, 1945. That is the day you die. Hitler: … Devil: I'll see you in Hell.
changes.TT3B/g1/r24: Once again, I'm pulled into a dimensional rift. Where am I going this time? Whose body will I wake up in next…? What am I supposed to do?!
